title: dForge Demo Data Variables
description: demo-data/vars.json: the variables demo-data formulas read as @name. A flat map of variable name to value. It is not a data file; the loader skips it, and each module has its own (nothing is shared between modules).

propertyNames.description: A letter or underscore, then letters, digits or underscores. Names are case-insensitive, and a repeat variable of the same name shadows the file's.

additionalProperties.description: A plain value (string, number, boolean or null) is substituted as a literal. { "$f": "..." } is a formula expanded where the variable is used, e.g. { "$f": "DATEADD(TODAY(), -30, 'DAY')" }; it may read other variables with @name (a cycle fails the install) but not [column] values.

$f.description: Formula whose result is the variable's value
